summary: topSwell skips a component when EITHER height or period is non-positive; redact-credential list carries no duplicate field.
reason: A swell with height 0 but period > 0 has zero energy yet passed the AND guard and could surface as the top swell (0 ft at a real period) in now/rank; the OR guard drops any component carrying no meaningful signal. The credential-redaction list had AccessToken registered twice (a no-op under the dedup map but a copy-paste hazard that would mis-mask a future field).
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test all pass; topSwell unit behavior unchanged for valid swells.
